patterns.note: The page uses an extensive amount of white space, particularly in the upper and middle sections, creating a sense of openness and directing focus to key text elements.
Header elements ('works', 'artem shcherbakov', 'contact') are spread across the top, maintaining a loose, almost scattered feel rather than a tight navigation bar.
A very bold, rounded sans-serif typeface is used for the main headlines ('I'm Artem', 'I've directed...') to create high visual impact and a friendly, modern tone.
Hand-drawn, scribbled lettering ('hey') is overlaid on the main name to introduce a playful and personal touch, contrasting with the structured typography.
A high-contrast black-on-white color scheme dominates, with vibrant neon green used sparingly as an accent for hand-drawn elements and specific text highlights.
The main hero content features an introductory name and a separate, more detailed bio aligned to the right, creating a split focus in the initial view.
A prominent list of directed projects is presented as a large, centralized block of text below the fold, acting as the primary portfolio showcase.

technique_notes: Achieve a personal and dynamic brand identity by combining a bold, standard typeface with an overlaid, hand-sketched graphic element, such as an SVG or image, to create visual texture and individuality.
Implement a minimalist page structure using generous white space to emphasize key content blocks and create an airy, uncrowded user experience.

Employ a strong typographic hierarchy by utilizing an extremely bold, rounded sans-serif font for headlines and titles to grab attention, contrasted with a lighter weight, readable sans-serif for body copy.
